system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Diplomacy and Society, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Lore of your faith, Lore of a religious order, Funerary Rites Lore.
system.description: You tended a shrine and learned to offer comfort or speak with religious authority. Something beyond its walls eventually demanded more of you than prayer.
